text:
rachel-peopleops: Flagging an issue — three interview panels this morning were created with the wrong local time in the calendar invite. Interviewers in APAC saw invites 8 hours off. Candidates had the right time.

omar-recruiting: How is candidate correct but interviewer wrong? Seems like timezone handling diverged between candidate/outbound email flow and interviewer calendar sync.

rachel-peopleops: Right. The ATS bulk export used to include `timezone` per slot. A recent ATS schema change made `timezone` optional and the mapper started defaulting to system_tz (UTC) for interviewer side but using candidate_tz for candidate emails.

jin-eng: Can you paste a sanitized slot payload?

rachel-peopleops: Sample from bulk export (sanitized):
```
{
  "slot_id": "S-2026-88",
  "start_local": "2026-12-03T09:00:00",
  "candidate_timezone": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "interviewer_timezone": null,  // used to be a zone here
  "assigned_interviewers": ["evie@redwood.com"],
  "created_by": "bulk-export-v2"
}
```

calendarbot: [calendar-sync] 2026-12-03T07:05:11Z WARN missing_tz fallback=UTC slot=S-2026-88 user=evie@redwood.com

evie-interviewer: I accepted an invite that showed my interview at 17:00 local but it actually happened at 09:00 my time. I missed logging in. Not good.

jin-eng: Confirmed root cause: mapping lambda dropped `interviewer_timezone` when null and the scheduler writing to calendar used UTC fallback. Candidate emails used `candidate_timezone` when present which is why candidates saw correct local times. Fix plan: (1) restore mapping to propagate participant-specific tz if present, (2) when interviewer_timezone is missing, infer from directory profile (primary_locale) instead of falling back to UTC, (3) backfill upcoming interviews (next 48h) that were created by bulk-export-v2 where calendar events were created with fallback tz.

omar-recruiting: Priority: high for candidate experience & interviewer reliability. We need to notify affected interviewers and ensure invites are updated without leaking internal notes. Also ensure reschedule options if they missed the interview.

rachel-peopleops: I can draft the recruiter-facing template: "Hi {interviewer}, we discovered an issue where some calendar invites used the wrong timezone. We've updated your invite to the correct local time; please check your calendar and reach out if you need to reschedule. Apologies for the disruption."

jin-eng: I'll push a mapper hotfix to staging now to re-add the `interviewer_timezone` accessor and add the directory lookup fallback. ETA 35m. We'll run a dry-run backfill to detect how many events.

calendarbot: [dry-run] 2026-12-03T07:40:00Z dry_run matched=18 query=(created_by=bulk-export-v2 AND start_local>=now() AND calendar_event.tz=UTC)

omar-recruiting: 18 upcoming events — thanks. Please tag patches with `tz-backfill-20261203` and include operator metadata for audit. We'll prepare candidate-safe messaging for any reschedules.

jin-eng: Deployed mapping fix to prod. Backfill script will: for each matched slot, compute inferred interviewer tz (directory -> `profile.timezone`), if missing ask recruiter to confirm; PATCH calendar_event to the correct tz and send updated invite. For rows without a profile tz, we'll queue for manual review rather than auto-change. Dry-run showed 12 could be auto-fixed, 6 queued for manual.

calendarbot: [backfill] 2026-12-03T08:25:00Z INFO patched=12 queued_manual=6 tag=tz-backfill-20261203 user=jin-eng

rachel-peopleops: Confirmed patches: 12 invites updated. For the 6 queued, Omar please reach out to the assigned recruiters to confirm timezone from interviewer before changing.

omar-recruiting: Will do, sending those 6 to recruiting ops now. Also adding a short FAQ in invite body for interviewers: "If the time looks wrong, click 'Check my timezone' or contact recruiting@redwood.com" Keep it candidate-safe.

evie-interviewer: Thanks for fixing mine. FYI, missed interview — recruiter offered to reschedule and candidate was okay. Please consider an auto-snooze option for interviewers who missed within 30m.

jin-eng: Adding a monitor: alert if >2 calendar events created with tz=UTC when candidate_timezone != UTC in 1h. Also adding unit tests for mapping nullable timezone fields and integration test with bulk-export-v2 sample.

rachel-peopleops: Can we also add a lint rule that CI fails mapping deploys that drop participant-specific timezone keys? Would have caught this.

jin-eng: Yep, adding schema check to the build pipeline. Also adding an audit note to each patched invite: "tz corrected via tz-backfill-20261203; contact recruiting if you need reschedule."

omar-recruiting: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the 6 manual checks and confirm closure when done.

calendarbot: [monitor] 2026-12-03T09:00:00Z INFO monitor_run check=tz-mismatch threshold=2/hour current=0

rachel-peopleops: Closing loop for now  12 auto-fixed, 6 manual pending, mapper fix + tests + monitor in place. Great job team. :white_check_mark:
